title: Rational points on modular curves: parameterization and geometric explanations
summary: We show that, conditional on Zywina's effective version of the Serre uniformity conjecture, there is a natural way to parameterize non-CM $\mathbb{Q}$-rational points on all modular curves in terms of the rational points on finitely many modular curves. Our proof refines Zywina's work to give a (conditional) parameterization of the images of adelic Galois representations of elliptic curves. In particular, we show that there are 41 $j$-invariants of elliptic curves whose associated Galois image does not vary in an infinite family.
